title: Reading at a clamped offset
statement: Let $x$ be a finite binary string, let $k$ be a natural number, let $S$ be a type of machine states, and let $c$ be a configuration of a $k$-tape Turing machine on input $x$. For any $i \in \mathbb{N}$, if the input-head position of $c$ is the clamped position corresponding to $i$, then the symbol read by the head is the optional entry $x[i]?$.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
The input-head position of $c$ equals the clamped position for $i$
replaced:
If a configuration's input position equals the clamped offset $i$ on input $x$,
then its input symbol is the optional $i$-th entry of $x$ (blank beyond the
boundary).
